item.title: 📣 Teachers, parents, and students—we need your help!
item.description:
📣 Teachers, parents, and students—we need your help!
Tag your school in the comments! The school with the most tags will win a $100 teacher’s lounge fridge restock from Launch Arlington!
Share this post with your school community—the more people who tag your school, the better your chances of winning!
Only tags on the original post will count. Winner announced September 25!

Every day counts, and every student matters!
